statement: The function returns a result r, and r = max_{B in S} factor_score(B), where S = { nums } ∪ { nums with element i removed for 0 <= i < len(nums) }, and for a non-empty array B, factor_score(B) = gcd(B) * lcm(B) with gcd(B) the greatest common divisor of the elements of B and lcm(B) the least common multiple of the elements of B; for the empty array, factor_score = 0.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), nums[i] >= 1; and for every array B in S (defined below), if B is non-empty then lcm(B) <= 2^63 - 1 and gcd(B)*lcm(B) <= 2^63 - 1.
